summary: A soft, slow meditation and sleep companion with guided sessions, mood check-ins and night-themed sleep stories that help you ease stress, rest deeply and find focus.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.spec: Three slow slides on a warm cream background. Slide one shows a calm illustration of a moon over still water with the line 'Breathe in. You're here.'. Slide two asks 'What brings you to Hushwell?' with three large soft cards: Ease stress (anxiety colour), Sleep better (sleep colour), Find focus (focus colour). Maya picks Sleep better. Slide three confirms 'We'll start gently, 10 minutes a day' with a reminder time of 9:30 PM. The primary 'Begin' button opens today.

screens.name: Today
screens.spec: Opens with a time-of-day greeting, 'Good evening, Maya', and a small flame pill showing the 6-day streak. The hero is a soft gradient card recommending 'Unwind After Work', 10 min with Elena Ward, plus a Play button that opens player. Below it, a 'How are you feeling?' row of five mood faces (Awful, Low, Okay, Good, Calm) with today's 'Okay' selected. A 'Continue' row shows 'Body Scan for Rest' at 4 of 12 min, and a 'Tonight' teaser card for the story 'The Lighthouse Keeper' opens sleep-stories.

screens.name: Library
screens.spec: Starts with a large 'Library' title and a search field. A row of category chips follows: Sleep, Anxiety, Focus and Breathing, each in its palette colour, with Anxiety selected. Below are a featured wide card for 'Soften the Worry', 12 min, and a two-column grid of session cards with photos, titles, guide names and duration pills. Tapping any card opens player.

screens.name: Sleep Stories
screens.spec: A dark night-theme screen with a deep indigo starfield header that reads 'Drift off, Maya' and the subtitle 'Tonight's story'. The hero is 'The Lighthouse Keeper', narrated by Thomas Reed, 32 min, with a glowing Listen button that opens player. Below it are 'New this week' and 'Narrator favourites': a list of story cards with photos, narrators and durations, plus a sleep timer pill (45 min) and a 'Wind-down sounds' row of Rain, Ocean, Fireplace and Brown noise.

screens.name: Your Progress
screens.spec: The hero is a big figure, 58 minutes this week, with a soft bar chart of minutes for Mon–Sun beneath it, where today (Thu) is highlighted. Two tiles follow: the current streak of 6 days and the longest streak of 14 days. A mood trend line covers the last 7 days, from Low up to Calm, with mood faces on the axis. A 'By category' breakdown shows the minutes for Sleep, Anxiety, Focus and Breathing as coloured bars.

screens.name: Profile
screens.spec: A soft avatar header shows Maya Lindqvist, a member since August, and the goal 'Sleep better'. Three totals sit beneath it: 47 sessions, 612 minutes and a 14-day longest streak. Next comes a 'Saved' list of favourite sessions, each of which opens player. The settings rows are Daily reminder 9:30 PM, Bedtime mode, Ambient sound default (Rain), Hushwell Plus (active, renews Nov 3) and Help. The screen ends with a quiet 'Change goal' button that reopens the goal question from welcome.

screens.name: Now Playing
screens.spec: A full-screen calm player with a large rounded artwork (dusk over a quiet lake) and the title 'Unwind After Work' with the guide's name 'Elena Ward'. In the centre, a progress ring timer reads 3:42 of 10:00. Below it sit the controls: back 15s, a big play/pause button, forward 15s. An ambient sound toggle row lets the user switch Rain, Ocean or Forest at a soft volume (Rain is on), and a chevron at the top dismisses the player.
